literal_source_claim_zh: 四色定理的可约构形与放电法
literal_source_claim_en: Reducible configurations and the discharging method for the four-color theorem.
statement_blocker: The catalog phrase names reducible configurations and discharging, not a proposition. It does not select the ordinary four-color conclusion, an unavoidable-set theorem, a fixed conjunction of configuration reducibility results, correctness of a historical program/certificate corpus, or the full Appel-Haken proof suite. It also conflates a 1976 announcement with detailed 1977 Parts I and II and omits Koch from the Part II authorship. Choosing a convenient root would invent mathematics or collapse neighboring targets.
